verdict.rationale: Terraform CLI is designed for non-interactive/CI use: -auto-approve skips prompts, -input=false disables interactive input, -json flags on plan/apply/show/validate produce machine-readable output, and detailed-exitcode enables CI gating. A hands-on probe confirms a full headless plan→apply→drift-check→destroy loop with proper exit codes and JSON parsing, exactly matching CI automation needs. Missing for 10: no independent (non-vendor) CI pipeline case study or third-party report of large-scale automated use.
